QuestInfo.name: Maple Island Disaster
QuestInfo.0: You receive an urgent message from Sugar on Maple Island.
QuestInfo.1: You can return to Maple Island by either using the Maple Return skill or asking Olaf in Lith Harbor. Return and meet Lucas, the chief of Amherst.
QuestInfo.2: You return to Maple Island after receiving an urgent message from Sugar and find the island in flames. Speak with Chief Lucas of Amherst to find out what happened.
